subject: fix(material): remove legacy components (#27622)
review_scope: Complete original commit and branch-native source exclusion judgment; separate canonical admission remains required
proposed_reason: The complete original patch removes 702 files and modifies 44 files in 97 nondeletion hunks. Its legacy-surface deletion, Sass/test coverage removal and MDC demo migration are incompatible with this add-on retaining Material-16 legacy contracts. The actual21.x tree retains44 primary/testing configurations, all57 original spec-path counterparts and all29 tagged legacy Sass forward bindings. All458 tagged API export names are accounted for at name level:449 remain and9 are the unchanged engine-recipe removals authenticated through original aliases and existing policy. Upstream-only Bazel, demos, generated reports and documentation cleanup require no product adoption. This is a source-only exclusion judgment, not complete API/runtime/native/floor/audit acceptance.
